title: Just Juice Bar Below Zero Triple Mango 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Triple Mango from the Just Juice Bar Below Zero Range is a burst of tropical sunshine in a premium Nic Salt. A trio of Mango notes delivers layers of juicy sweetness, capturing the lush, sun-ripened flavour of ripe Mango with remarkable depth and clarity. Finished with a soft breeze of icy menthol, this uplifting flavour makes for an endlessly refreshing all-day vape. Crafted with nicotine salts, this e-liquid provides smooth delivery and rapid nicotine absorption, tailored for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits such as pod systems and pens. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, it caters to a range of preferences. Produced in the UK, Just Juice Bar Below Zero Range Nic Salts use a 60PG/40VG formulation for pronounced flavour and discreet vapour, bringing disposable-inspired flavour profiles into a convenient 10ml refill format. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Below Zero Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
